query:
SELECT id, status, totalCards, processedCards, successCount, failCount, startedAt, completedAt, 
  TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, startedAt, completedAt) as durationSeconds,
  ROUND(processedCards / NULLIF(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, startedAt, completedAt), 0), 2) as cardsPerSecond
FROM batchUpdateJobs 
WHERE id IN (870001, 870002)
ORDER BY id DESC;
